original_c64_reference.comparison_limit: Historical P8192, not a contemporaneous matched control. Original C16/C64 input audit found one repeated full input; see baseline CACHE_AND_BOTTLENECK.md.

decode_phase.mean_denominator: decode active phase window, not full-run window

cache.scope: P local hits use total prompt tokens as denominator; external hits are a fraction of local misses. D external ratio applies only to external queries/local misses, not all prompts.

configuration.fused_mc2_reporting: requested setting; per-step path not sampled

full_run.input_tokens_per_second_scope: input tokens include prefix-cache-hit tokens; not newly computed input-token throughput

native_stable.input_tokens_per_second_scope: input tokens include prefix-cache-hit tokens; not newly computed input-token throughput

selector_window_condition.rule: max E2E over all timed successful requests <= selected window / 3

sampled_service_concurrency.window_definition: client request interval by sample time_ns

limitations: Single C64/N384 screening run; not a repeated capacity certification.
Native stable TPS and quantiles follow AISBench's selected-request/window algorithm; they are not a strict count of work completed within the client wall window.
Native-window confidence condition uses maximum E2E across all timed successful requests and is separate from SLA gates.
Input TPS includes cached logical input tokens and does not represent newly computed prefill tokens per second.
D external cache hit percentage is conditional on external queries for local misses; it is not an overall hit rate.
NPU/AI Core utilization does not by itself establish compute or interconnect saturation.
The original manifest retains an inherited c48_ttft5 label; the separate correction sidecar establishes this run as C64 graph_dense and remains unchanged.
